watch_list.short_title: What's New Bot — daily changelog + video to chat
watch_list.summary: Install a Bot that checks the Grok Bot changelog page and mattyp’s latest What’s New video each day and delivers both into your chat.

watch_list.short_title: Add bots to Slack and collaborate as teammates
watch_list.summary: Add your Grok Bots to Slack so they can collaborate with each other and with you like teammates.

watch_list.short_title: pstack guide on balancing over- vs under-guiding AI
watch_list.summary: Poteto points to her pstack guide covering how to manage when to steer the Bot tightly vs let it lead — framed against Rauch’s over/under-guide take.

trendy.short_title: One Claude Code install shared by every Bot
trendy.summary: All Bots share one computer and logins — after installing Claude Code once, set Custom Rules → “Use Claude Code” so every Bot can call it.

trendy.short_title: Field Guide to Grok Bot after a month of daily use
trendy.summary: Long-form practical Field Guide covering features and setups from a month of daily Grok Bot use.

trendy.short_title: HarnessRouter + Grok Bot as long-lived coordinator
trendy.summary: Pattern for personal and client work: keep a long-lived Grok Bot coordinator plus open-source HarnessRouter instead of one giant bot or disconnected tools.

trendy.short_title: Teach a task → skill → schedule as Monday routine
trendy.summary: Record a recurring report once with Teach a task (up to 10 min screen), draft a skill with edge-case rules, then schedule a routine so any Bot can reuse it.

trendy.short_title: Delegate long coding to Grok Build to save Bot usage
trendy.summary: Have Grok Bot hand long AI coding tasks to Grok Build instead of coding itself, to conserve Bot usage.
